The series is trend‑dominated with high predictability; a robust trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier‑like correlated errors.
test a robust dba combination on the full pool to see if iterative refinement beats weighted softmax.
Test a weighted combination with inverse_error to see if a simple error‑based weighting improves over dba.
Test a weighted softmax combination over the smaller, diverse pool1 to see if restricting to highly correlated groups improves robustness in a trend‑dominated series.
test a weighted combination on a slightly different pool (pool2) to see if removing some models improves robustness given trend-dominated, unstable ranking.

Test a weighted combination on the smaller, more stable pool1 with inverse_error weights to see if a simpler error‑based scheme improves over the full‑pool weighted approach, leveraging the stable subset of key models.
The series is trend dominated with unstable ranking; a robust weighted softmax on a more diverse pool might capture complementary errors across the five correlation groups.
The trend is very strong and ranking unstable; a robust dba on a smaller, diverse pool might improve stability.
The series has high trend and moderate seasonality; a robust, simple aggregation like median over the full pool may handle rank instability and correlated errors.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking, so a robust weighted combo with inverse‑error may help. I’ll test weighted on pool3 using inverse_error weights.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.969. Series context: trend strength 0.9294 and seasonal strength 0.3964; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.111); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.495.
